home_hero_desc: We promote the joy of reading by making books free and accessible. We aspire to reach readers across the world in every language.
home_what_we_do_desc: Our goal is to instill a lifelong passion for reading in people of all ages worldwide. We provide free access to a world of literature, ensuring that the transformative power of a good book is always within reach.
home_partners_desc: A special thanks to our partners.
home_help_spread: Help us spread the joy of reading
home_cta_title: Help Us Spread the Joy of Reading
home_cta_desc: Every great story needs a champion. Your support allows us to write and illustrate more books for Booktime, license new material for Safahat, and improve Folios.
donate_intro_title: Help us spread the joy of reading!
donate_intro_desc: Everyone deserves access to literature, and to experience the joy of reading. Your support directly fuels our global mission, allowing us to publish more books, expand into new languages, and improve our technology. Whether you give once or monthly, your generosity helps us break down language barriers and reach more readers worldwide.
donate_note: If you would like to speak to us about directing your donation toward a specific book, language, or project, please contact us at donations@hindawi.org.
